comments.author: ensign
comments.body:
AGILE LA ROYALE
OPTIONAL SKILLS

*Rowing Assistance (Special order light oar, High quality rigging)
*Pre-emptive attack (Traverse rope, Mast top)
*Improved ram (Traverse rope, Special all-purpose ram)
*Set fire (Control tower, Munitions chambers)
*Special sea mine (Special floating mine, Special Ship Hold)
*Roaring sea mine (Loud floating mine, Munitions chambers)
*Welcome Melee Battle (Stern deck, Admiral's cabin)
*Assault Deck Battle (Traverse rope, Assault Cabin)
*Deck Barrierer (Set of repair tools, Reinforced iron deck plating)

You can verify this information on OGPlanet website, the current page of Mystery Bottom, hidden in announcement of Maintenance Completed page, bottom of page, don't know why it's in small small small font...

comments.author: ensign
comments.body:
So it is considerably faster than FLR with all other stats and mod times etc. being the same. Then with a range of extra skills!

Deck Barrier for pirates that don't like to deck.
WMB + Roaring Sea Mines + inherited skill + original (rowing?) = PvP Boss

comments.author: Armie
comments.body: It is just a Shadow Hind with rowing but at the cost of less armor ...

comments.author: Emmilout
comments.body:
I won't say they are exact counterparts although they do share: (1) Roaring Sea Mines; (2) both fast ships.

ALR has a much larger crew (about 70 more sailors than SH) and Pre-Emptive (which isn't a burden against opponents with WMB but in great disorder from mines), or else it can choose WMB itself. One way or another it is a hardcore melee ship, great disorder >>> row in to clean deck.

SH is more of a cannon ship with Roaring Mines as support, it's like HSFCV, only with much less dura but looks cooler.
